message.content: The billing-service keeps timing out against the ledger API in staging. Can you look at the retry policy?

content.text: Found it: billing-service retries 10 times with no backoff, so a slow ledger call turns into a storm of requests. I suggest capping retries at 3 with exponential backoff starting at 200 ms.

message.content: Agreed. We decided: cap at 3 retries, exponential backoff from 200 ms, and a circuit breaker that opens after 5 failures in a minute. Document it in the runbook.

content.text: Done. The runbook now says: 3 retries max, backoff 200/400/800 ms, circuit breaker opens after 5 failures per minute and half-opens after 30 s.
